LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Flesh Idol
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Flesh Idol (T-09-79) is a grotesque cross encrusted with pulsating tissue and clockwork fragments.\nThose who endure twenty seconds of earnest prayer draw forth a colony-wide healing miracle, yet premature abandonment brings swift agony and over-devotion ends in a facility-wide detonation.
